label: preparing
what: Likely a coordinated gathering or surprise in the great hall, using the eighteen hundred lighting inspection to bring me there. Eighty contracted loaves have been delivered by freight, and the neighbour plans to accompany me or meet me there. Baker, innkeeper and neighbour were reported together at the bakery. The precise purpose is unknown; the bridge/port rumour is unconfirmed, and the lighting inspection could also be genuine.
